2: Ib. १५०. २२४; १५२. २५-52; २४५. ३२.
killed by दुर्गा;

--a Janapada of the भद्रा continent. वा. ४३. १९.

(I)--a son of Bharata, whom he succeeded. Elevated as a deity by पाखण्डस् as he followed the path of ऋषभ. His queen was वृद्धसेना and son देवताजित्. Father of Devadyumna through आसुरि;
1: भा.

; वा. ३३. ५३.
father of Tejas(a).
2: Br. II. १४. ६२; Vi.
(II)--a son of नृग and father of भूतज्योतिस्. भा.
(III)--a son of Somadatta and father of Jana- mejaya; was invited for the राजसूय of युधिष्ठिर. भा.
(IV)--a son of रन्तिभार, and father of Raibhya. भा. IX. २०. 6 & 7.
(V)--the son of सुपार्श्व, and father of सन्नतिमान्. भा. IX. २१. २८; M. ४९. ७४; वा. ९९. १८८; Vi. IV. १९. ४९.
(VI)--a son of Dyumatsena (धृडसेन) and father of Subala. भा. IX. २२. ४८.
(IX)--a son of Uttama Manu. Br. II. ३६. ४०.
(X)--one of the twenty अमिताभ gods. Br. II. ३६. ५३;
(XI)--a god of आभूतरय group. Br. II. ३६. ५५. [page३-648+ २७]
(XII)--a son of हर्यश्व and दृषद्वती. Br. III. ६३. ७५.

sons born by the grace of Aurva and known as सागरस्: out of long gourd; each of them entrusted to a nurse; became developed in nine months and in course of time attained youth.
2: भा.
(XIV)--a बृहद्रथ; for ३३ years. Br. III. ७४. ११९; वा. ९९. ३०५.
(XVI)--an Asura in the सभा of हिरण्य- कशिपु. M. १६१. ७९.
(XVII)--a pupil of सूत, रोमहर्षण. वा. ६१. ५५; ६२. ४६ and ४८; Vi.
(XVIII)--a son of Janamejaya; with him ends the वैशाल line. Vi.
(I)--a son of Ulmuka and पुष्करिणी. भा. IV. १३. १७. [page३-649+ २४]
(II)--a queen of Madhu and mother of वीरव्रत. भा. V. १५. १५.
(III)--a Mt. in प्लक्षद्वीप. Here वारह Vis2n2u killed हिरण्याक्ष. Br. II. १९. १२; वा. ४९. ११; Vi.
(IV)--a god of the प्रसूत group. Br. II. ३६. ७०.
(VI)--a son of मणिभद्र and पुण्यजनी; an यक्ष. Br.
(VIII)--the name of चक्रवाक in मानस; in previous birth a son of कौशिक. M. २०. १८.
(X)--same as आम्बिकेय of the शाकद्वीप. M. १२२. १६.
(XIII)--the son of Hasta and father of त्रिधन्वा. Vi.
(I)--a son of ऊरु (Kuru-वि। प्।). Br. II. ३६. १०८;
(II)--a गण of the IV सावर्ण Manu: in- cludes ३३ Tus2ita gods. Br.
(III)--one of the five deva गणस् of the epoch of ऋथु Sa1varn2a; a mind-born son of ब्रह्मा with ten branches. वा. १००. ८७.
(IV)--a group of ten gods of the XII epoch of Manu. Vi.
(I)--a sage who was invited for the राजसूय of युधिष्ठिर. भा. X. ७४. 7.

(II)--a son of Jaimini and father of Sutvan or Sunvan; learnt a सम्हिता of the साम वेद from him, divid- ed the अथर्व वेद into two divisions;
1: भा.

.
a pupil of व्यास, helped him in arranging the अथर्व वेद; in charge of the अथर्वान्गिरस् (Atharva Veda); Kabandha, the pupil of, to whom was given by him the whole of the अथर्व वेद। ^2 भा.
(III)--a son of अट्टहास अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १९३.
(IV)--a son of Janhu; and father of Ajaka. Vi.
(V)--a Mt. that entered the sea for fear of Indra. M. १२१. ७३.

. ९०.
the राक्षस king in IV Talam; served as calf when they milked the earth.
3: Ib. II. २०. ३३; ३६. २१९.
(II)--a son of खश and a राक्षस. Br.
(IV)--a son of महापद्म; all the sons of महापद्म ruled for a hundred years after which nine of them were done away with by कौटल्य. Vi. २४. २३-6. भा.
(I)--a son of Suratha: the last of बार्हद्बलस् and of इक्ष्वाकुस् of the Kaliyuga. भा. IX. १२. १५-16; Br. III. ७४. १०६; २४४; M. २७१. १४. १६; वा. ९९. २९०; Vi. IV. २२. १०-13.
(II)--a son of वृष्णि and गान्धारी, had a son, Anamitra. भा. IX. २४. १२; Br. III. ७१. १९; M. ४५. 1; Vi. IV. १३. 8, 9.
(III)--a son of शमीक and सुदामिनी. भा. IX. २४. ४४.
(IV)--a son of कृष्ण and जाम्बवती: fought with Suratha at प्रभास. भा. X. ६१. ११; XI. ३०. १६.
(V)--a son of Uttama Manu. Br. II. ३६. ४०.
(VI)--a sage who waited among others on परशूराम for the reclamation of गोकर्ण. Br. III. ५१. 7. [page३-653+ २२]
(IV)--a son of Suhotri, the अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १२७.
--one of the 9 sons of Ugrasena. M. ४४. ७५.
--a Janapada of the भद्रा continent. वा. ४३. २०. [page३-654+ २४]
--the father of ऋतुस् whose sons are five known as आर्तवस्; considered as प्रपितामह, as by it people die and are born. वा. ३०. १६, १९.
--a son of जैगिषव्य, an अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १३९.
(I)--a daughter of सुकन्या and Cyavana: wife of Nidhurva and mother of कुण्ड pa1yins. Br.
(II)--a R. of the केतुमाला country. वा. ४४. १७.
--a Mt. to the east of अरुणोद where आदित्यस् and Vasus live. वा. ३६. १९; ३७. २६; ३९. ४८.
(I)--a god of Sumedhasa group. Br. II. ३६. ६०.
(III)--a sage of the चाक्षुष epoch. Vi.
--Medha, Medhatithi, Satyamedha, पृश्नि- medha, Alpamedha, दीप्तिमेध, यशोमेध, Sthira- medha, Sarvamedha, अश्वमेध, Pratimedha, Medhavat and Medhaharta. वा. ६२. ५१-2.
(I)--a group of gods of Raivata Manu: १४ in number. Br. II. ३६. ५१, ६०.
--one of the four queens of भण्ड. Br. IV. १२. १३.
--a Janapada of the केतुमाला country. वा. ४४. १०.
